200 Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management successfully changed the user password.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
any
— 400
Returned if your request specified invalid parameters or if your request was improperly formatted. For
example, if the new password is too short.
user_uuid
required
password
required
temporary
— 403 Returned if you do not have permission to change the user's password.
— 404 Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management cannot find the specified user.
— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
see Rate Limiting.
— 500 Returned if an internal error occurred in Tenable Vulnerability Management.
